'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|So, about that cargo from across the cordon. Turns out it was only part of the shipment. The other part's supposed to be airdropped. But I suspect they didn't include everything there either, those bastards. Look, you could help me with this. The package still needs to be picked up. And if we don't actually have everything, we'll have to look somewhere else. Obviously, I'm not gonna work with these suppliers anymore, but right now I need all these electronics from the shipment. I won't forget your commitment. Who knows, maybe I'll figure out how to help comrade driver quicker after you're done.}}

==Objectives==
* Hand over 5 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] military electronic items
* Hand over 10 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] PC component items

==Rewards==
* +14,900 [[EXP]]
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 123,000 Roubles
** 129,150 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 141,450 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 2× [[Altyn bulletproof helmet (Olive Drab)]]
* 2× [[Altyn helmet face shield]]
{{quote|You really helped me out! If the BTR driver is as reliable as you, we'll certainly get along. I just need to finish some other urgent things and prepare everything.}}
